$description: The document editor template's own component tokens: each aliases a core semantic role, so its parts follow the theme and every context.

gap.$description: Around the ribbon card and between the window's own parts.

surface.$description: Fields and document sheet (#FFFFFF light, #262626 dark).

search-bg.$description: Title-bar search box fill (#FAFAFA light, #1F1F1F dark).

copilot-bg.$description: Copilot right pane surface (#FAF9F8 light, #181818 dark).

copilot-chip.$description: Copilot prompt suggestion chips (#EFEFEF light, #2E2E2E dark).

border.$description: Hairlines on rulers, draft pill and ribbon.

border-strong.$description: Page sheet edge and chrome control borders.

muted.$description: Ruler numbers and draft prompt text.

badge-dot.$description: Notification dot on the plan button (#D13438).

mica-end.$description: Right-side title bar Mica gradient stop.

icon-green.$description: Green accent on comment-new, add-pen, smartart and set-default icons.

card-radius.$description: Ribbon and companion card radius (8 CSS px), preserved across compact chrome.

ruler-bg.$description: Outer margin band of horizontal and vertical rulers (#F2ECE8 light, #26221E dark).

icon-pink.$description: Eraser tip accent on Draw Stroke Eraser (#E083B8).

icon-slate.$description: Graphite pencil barrel on Draw Pencil (#849398).

icon-purple.$description: Notebook cover accent on Linked Notes (#7719AA).

icon-teal.$description: Teal globe and document metadata accent (#038387).
